snippet.title: Version 2.7 Teaser "Champions Never Fall to the Past" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
"When Hollows threaten the city, from the city rises a champion!"
"Laughable. Hollows don't give birth to heroes — only raw, unfiltered desire."

"Let's play a game that's more fitting for a Hollow, how about it?"

"Thanks for signing up for the Hollow Champion competition. Good luck out there!"

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
PS5·iOS·Android·PC·Xbox｜Version 2.6 "Encore for an Old Dream" of Zenless Zone Zero, HoYoverse's urban fantasy ARPG, is out now: https://hoyo.link/6SOkFDAL
